name: measurement_alias
oracle_basis: A sampled classical alias cannot be represented by an unconditional unitary trace.

original.source:
wires q: 1
bits c: 1
q <- h
c <- measure q
let mm = c
if mm == "1" { q <- x }

transfer.source:
wires q: 1
bits c: 1
q <- h
c <- measure q
let mm = c[0]
let nn = mm
repeat nn { q <- x }

control.source:
wires q: 1
q <- h
expect prob(q,"1") == 1/2
